headlines.title: Jack Smith testifies at Senate hearing
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as former special counsel Jack Smith testifies at a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing. He is expected to face questions on the federal cases he brought against President Trump that have since been dismissed.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy to Appear in Court for First Time Since Mistrial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy is headed back to court in Massachusetts for a pivotal hearing that could determine if she’ll face a second trial for the murders of her three children, after the first ended in a mistrial. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump says he will sign executive order naming AI as Super Intelligence
headlines.description: During an event launching the website America.gov, President Trump said that he will be signing an executive order renaming artificial intelligence to super intelligence.

headlines.title: Cornell Sexual Assault Investigation Reopened by Prosecutors
headlines.description: Prosecutors say they have now reopened the case of an alleged sexual assault at Cornell University with plans to have the former student, who’s now filed a civil lawsuit against the school, tell her story to a grand jury. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY. Warning: Some of the details of the lawsuit are disturbing.

headlines.title: 5 Men Arrested Near UK Air Base by US Forces Released on Bail
headlines.description: New details are emerging about the potential terror plot targeting a US-operated military base in the U.K, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio alleging for the first time that a foreign government was involved. Authorities decided to release all five suspects on bail without being charged. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Dennis Haskins, Principal on ‘Saved by the Bell,’ Dies at 75
headlines.description: Dennis Haskins, the actor best known for his role as the beloved principal of Bayside High, Mr. Belding, on the hit show “Saved by the Bell,” has died at 75. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Common Ground: The ever-expanding NFL community
headlines.description: NBC Sports announcer Mike Tirico leads a panel on the ever-expanding NFL community with former Super Bowl MVP Drew Brees, quarterback of Mexico's national flag football team Diana Flores and NFL's chief media officer Hans Schroeder. Common Ground is sponsored by Comcast.

headlines.title: Anger grows across Spain after elderly woman is evicted from her home of 70 years
headlines.description: An 87-year-old Spanish woman was forcibly evicted Wednesday from the Madrid apartment she had lived in for more than 70 years, in a case that highlights a growing housing crisis in the country.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Anne Hathaway says doctor warned her that ‘Hot Ones’ interview could induce early labor
headlines.description: Anne Hathaway’s career may be on fire, but her mouth won’t be anytime soon if her doctor has anything to do with it.

headlines.title: University of Georgia student dancing on couch near window falls 8 stories and survives
headlines.description: A University of Georgia student survived a plunge from her eighth-floor apartment, authorities said Monday, after she had been “dancing on a couch near a window” and fell out.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy returns to court for the first time since her mistrial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy and her legal team returned to court Tuesday, marking their first time back in the Massachusetts courtroom since her triple murder trial ended in a mistrial earlier this month.
